LanguageData.QP_EnableQuestPatchesTooltip: Tech gates for quests and site parts, quest factions, weapon rewards, lodger caps, wastepacks, no duplicate guest and monument quests. The wastepack curve fix is applied at startup and needs a restart to change.
LanguageData.QP_EnableEventPatchesTooltip: Tech gates for incidents and creepjoiner variants, faction filter for Raid Extension surprise events, Hospitality guest filter.
LanguageData.QP_LimitRefugeesTooltip: Refugees and beggars: count = colonists / 2, capped by the values below.\nHospitality guests and prisoners: count by player tech level (Neolithic 1-2, Medieval 2-4, Industrial 4-6).
LanguageData.QP_NerfWastepacksTooltip:
Reduces wastepack count in quests.
Base multiplier always applies.
Extra multiplier for early eras (Neolithic, Medieval).
Neolithic: 50% × 50% = 25% of vanilla.
LanguageData.QP_GuestsAlreadyPresent: Quest skipped — guests already present in colony.
LanguageData.QP_MonumentAlreadyActive: Quest skipped — monument quest already in progress.
